source.citation: [Group of striking women - shirtwaist workers. NYC. 1909], photograph, George Grantham Bain Collection. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, LOT 10855, LC-USZ62-41877 (item 2007682973); with its companion Strikes - shirtwaist workers, N.Y., LC-USZ62-78093 (item 2002705904).
what_it_does_not_supply: the summer hat of 1904 (these are winter hats of 1909)
anything about Chicago, the Glessner household or Christine Nelson; no likeness is asserted
what_it_supplies: a young working woman's street dress of the decade: shirtwaist with a tall collar, a bow tie, a belt, a dark skirt clear of the ground at the ankle
